name: trello
description: Work with Trello boards, lists, and cards using the user's own API key and token. Load for board/list/card reads and creating cards.

content.inline:
## Trello
A multi-value connection: Trello carries **both** credentials in the query string. Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.trello.com/1`, appending `key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}` to every request URL. The venue resolves both placeholders and masks them out of every job record; you never write the literal values.

Common calls (append `?key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}`, or `&` if the path already has a query):
- Whoami: `GET /members/me?key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}`
- Your boards: `GET /members/me/boards?fields=name,url&key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}`
- Lists on a board: `GET /boards/{boardId}/lists?key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}`
- Cards in a list: `GET /lists/{listId}/cards?key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}`
- Create a card: `POST /cards?idList={listId}&name=<encoded>&key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}`
- Comment: `POST /cards/{cardId}/actions/comments?text=<encoded>&key={s/TRELLO_KEY}&token={s/TRELLO_TOKEN}`

Rules:
- Check `status`; a bad key or token returns `401` with the plain text `invalid token` / `invalid key`.
- URL-encode free text (`name`, `text`) with `v/ops/jvm/url-encode`.
- Both the key and the token must be configured.
